topPick.thesis: Allstate (ALL) is trading at 6.0x P/E, a 63% discount to its sector average of 16.0x; RSI at 65 reflects strong but extended momentum — watch for potential consolidation. Three-month price momentum of +25.5% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +338% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 77/100 places ALL in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +14.2% over the past quarter.
